title: Golden Multi-Pack Narrative Compatibility Proof
objective: Close the CNI family with deterministic Golden Multi-Pack Narrative Compatibility proof using multiple original Multiversal fixture/first-party packs across the completed CNI-01..12 foundations while preserving canonical owner, visibility, rights and activation authorities.

scope.purpose: Prove the completed CNI family end to end with multiple original first-party packs without turning proof fixtures into canonical owner state or creating new sharing, marketplace, rights, visibility or runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: Multiple original Multiversal packs deterministically exercise the completed CNI capability chain while preserving owner/visibility/rights/runtime authority boundaries.

selection_boundaries: CNI-01 through CNI-12 and MAS-01 through MAS-21 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.
Golden proof used original Multiversal first-party/noncanonical evidence only; copyrighted Candlekeep/Baldur's Gate proof content was not authorized or used.
CNI-13 remained proof/integration only and created no canonical owner-domain state authority, public sharing, marketplace, rights, visibility or parallel runtime authority.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN 3ed1b93e93d14078dfd91ad6b459306568623128; proof-layer commits added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after CNI-13. PCA start requirements are satisfied and CNI-13 supplies PCA's golden-proof requirement; no rotation edge supersedes PCA-01, so PCA-01 is selected_not_started.
PCA-01 receives no implementation branch or authority until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: CNI-13 and the CNI implementation family are closed. PCA-01 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
